changes: Static image overlays deliver a texture once instead of busy-looping allocation and copy.
Expose actual selected Sink Writer video encoder hardware attribute and name.
Refuse unverified or software encoders when hardware encoding is requested.
Bounded encoder input texture reuse using IMFTrackedSample release callbacks; no blind ring-buffer overwrite.
Static PNG ImageReader overlays share the main protected D3D11 device/context without shader initialization; GIF/video/WGC paths remain independent.
name: ScreenRecorderLib

encoderTexturePool.bytesMetric: Peak nominal BGRA pixel bytes; excludes driver padding and other GPU allocations.

staticImageDeviceSharing.context: Main immediate context with existing multithread protection
staticImageDeviceSharing.ownership: Independent AddRef/Release per overlay; non-PNG replacement falls back to original device initialization
staticImageDeviceSharing.pipelineState: Device-only upload; no ImageReader shader or input-layout initialization
staticImageDeviceSharing.sharedSurface: Existing shared handle, Flush and canvas keyed-mutex notification retained
